name: verglas
description: Parallel evaluated exploration for clean, architecturally sound coding solutions

interface.shortDescription: Explore clean coding solutions in parallel.
interface.longDescription: RIME reproduces a measurable coding objective, explores independent candidate solutions with a low-cost worker preference, rejects dead code, fallback paths, point fixes, and guessed semantics, then selects from evidence-backed results.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use RIME when low-cost-preferred, independently evaluated parallel exploration is worthwhile for this coding task.
